statement: Reasonix plugin manifests can contribute hooks and MCP servers, while lazy MCP placeholders keep cached tool metadata stable and defer process startup or live schema reconciliation until needed.

display_text.zh-CN: Reasonix plugin manifest 可以贡献 hooks 与 MCP servers；lazy MCP placeholder 会保持缓存的工具元数据稳定，并将进程启动或 live schema reconciliation 延迟到需要时。
display_text.en: Reasonix plugin manifests can contribute hooks and MCP servers, while lazy MCP placeholders keep cached tool metadata stable and defer process startup or live schema reconciliation until needed.
